༄༅/ /che mchog pad+ma thod phreng gi sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam bzhag nyung ngu'i tshul du bkod pa blo dman rnams kyi rtogs pa rdo rja

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /che mchog pad+ma thod phreng gi sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam bzhag nyung ngu'i tshul du bkod pa blo dman rnams kyi rtogs pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /pad+ma thod phreng la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi/ /rnam dbye go bde'i ngag 'di nyon/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad nyi la/ /srin po zhing chen bsnol ba'i steng / /bla ma rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus de'i drung du/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /byams dang snying rje kun blangs nas/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gro bya/ /bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la/ /bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /gsum bdun nyer gcig la sogs brjod/ /na mo sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas kyang / /gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyi/ /'gro ba sgrol ba sems bskyed do/ /gsum mam ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ /hūm̐ chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje yis/ /pad+ma rgyal po 'di nyid gsungs/ /dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing / /smra bsam brjod bral rdzogs pa che/ /blo 'das chos sku ming 'gyur ba'i/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom/ /blo bral de yis ngang nas ni/ /sems can kun la khyab pa yis/ /brtse ba'i snying rje chen por bsgom/ /kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /stong nyid snying rje ngang can de/ /'gro don dpag med byed pa la/ /rgyu yi ting 'dzin rang gi sems/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge dmar por gyur/ /e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐/ /e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med/ /yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gtam/ /raṃ las khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal/

/kaṃ las keng rus ri rab btsal/ /raṃ las bskal ba'i me phung 'bar/ /bh+rūṃ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang / /phyi ni thod rlon bar ni snying / /skam pos nang byas rtsigs pa can/ /gnam lcags gzer btab gru bzhi pa/ /sgo bzhi zhing gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /tshangs pa pho mo'i ka gdung can/ /zhing lpags thog dang bla res dang / /sgyu ma'i drwa phyed don snying 'phyang / /phyi nang me dpung smug nag 'bar/ /gzhal yas khang pa de yi nang / /'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa/ /mu khyud rdo rje rwa bas bskor/ /dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /zla gam dmar nag gsum dang bcas/ /gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol du/ /gser gyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor/ /de'i rtse sdig pas mtshan pa'o/ /me yi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor/ /rtse bsnol bar du dgra bgegs 'joms/ /de rgyab rdo rje gur khang phug /phyi rol ye shes me phung 'bar/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad bsregs/ /dbus su paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal la/ /ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la/ rak+ṣa pa ti ra baṃ/ pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i steng / /srin po zhing chen bsnol ba'i dbus/ /hūm̐ yig dmar po bsam pa las/ /phyogs bcur 'od 'phros sangs rgyas kyi/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul 'gro don byas/ /tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa las/ /bdag nyid zil gnon pad+ma'i sku/ /dmar po me yi 'phreng bas brgyan/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brkyang bskum bgrad/ /g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pas lcags sdig kha dgu bsnams/ /dbu skra snum 'bol gyen du 'khyil/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la spras/ /dbu dang phyag zhabs sbrul gyis brgyan/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi lpags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /de yi spyi gtsug bya khyung rgyal/

/mthing nag me yi gshog pa gdengs/ /gnam lcags me yi tsha tsha 'phro/ /de steng pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' yas/ /sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag can/ /dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /sku yi ngo bo tshon gang pa/ /dpral ba'i mdzod spu'i khro gnyer steng / /gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i dbus/ /'jam dpal sku mdog gser gyi mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu brgyan can/ /phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri bsnams/ /g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /cung zad khro tshul 'gying bag can/ /de nyid spyi bo yi ge oṃ/ /gser mdog bdag sku byin rlob bo/ /mgrin pa pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar/ /spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu can/ /rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su sgrog /g.yas pas rdo rje dbyug pa 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thugs khar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /brkyang bskum dor stabs bzhugs pa'o/ /de yi mgrin par yi ge ā/ /dmar po bdag gsung byin gyis brlabs/ /thugs khar gser gyi mchod rten ser/ /ri rab bam rim bum pa bre/ 'khor lo tog dang ldan par bsgom/ /bum par phyag na rdo rje ni/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pas thugs khar sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /khro gtum drag po brjid pa'i sku/ /de yi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag /bdag thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /sku yi yi ge oṃ las ni/ /'od zer ser po 'phros pa yis/ /sku yi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas/ /mdzod spu'i 'jam dpal dag la thim/ /sku mi shigs rdo rje'i dbang thob gyur/ /gsung gi snying po ā las ni/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ /gsung gi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas/ /mgrin pa'i rta mgrin bdag la thim/ /gsung 'gags pa med pa'i dbang thob gyur/ /thugs kyi yi ge hūm̐ las ni/ /'od zer mthing nag 'phros pa yis/ /thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs nas/

/thugs ka'i phyag rdor dag la thim/ /thugs 'khrul ba med pa'i dbang thob gyur/ /ye shes gsum las 'od zer gsum/ /phyogs bcu rnams su 'phros pa yis/ /rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang / /gzhan yang rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ /snang ba mtha' yas bdag la thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las la sogs dbang thob gyur/ /de nas bdag gi thugs ka nas/ /rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ dmar las/ /'od zer nag po grangs med 'phros/ /hūm̐ nag grangs med 'jig rten khams/ /snang srid thams cad gang bar bsam/ /hūm̐ rnams 'od du zhu ba las/ /khro bo yak+sha me dbal ni/ /nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar/ /g.yon pas brdung ba'i tho ba bsnams/ /sku la bskal pa'i me phung 'bar/ /de 'dra'i khro bo snang srid khengs/ /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /gnod sbyin gdon bgegs ma lus pa/ /'dar zhing dngangs nas brgyal dang bgegs/ /brdung zhing bsregs nas bsad par gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ /pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'dul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadag la thim/ /thugs ka'i phyag rdor hūm̐ dag la/ /snying po gsham bur bcas pa'i sngags/ /phreng ba phreng thag brgyus pa ltar/ /g.yas bskor dag tu 'khor bar bsam/ /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ artsig nertsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ drag po'i rtsa sngags 'di nyid la/ /khri tsho gcig gi grangs bzlas na/ /drag po'i dgra bgegs thams cad thul/ /'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na/ /mchog gi dngos grub ma lus thob/ /thos dang dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten lha srin thams cad rnams/

/las la bskos pa the tshom med/ /gal te gdug can gzir 'dod na/ /bdag nyid pad+ma'i zhal sgo nas/ /'od zer spu gri ltar 'bar ba/ /grangs med phyi ru 'phros pa dang / /mdun du yak+ṣa me dbal bsam/ /de'i zhal nas 'od zer ni/ /gong dang 'dra ba'i tshur 'phros pa'i/ /rtse bsnol bar du dgra bgegs rnams/ /bsad cing gtub par bsam byas la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni sham bu bzla/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐/ yak+ṣa hūm̐/ rak+ṣa hūm̐/ gnod byed gdon bgegs bse mo dam sri'i snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rā dza'i snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ /'phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug nas/ /sngags kyi bzlas slar phog byas la/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad la/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad nas su/ /myur du mchog gi dngos grub ni/ /che mchog pad+ma thod phreng gi /go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /thun mtshams gtor ma 'bul 'dod na/ /sman raka gtor ma mchod par bcas/ /gtsang zhing bzang ba bshams nas su/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sngags de gnyis kyis bsang sbyang bya/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me'i steng / /ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod mchog tu/ /sman gtor rak+ta ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang / /thod pa'i snod du mchod rdzas tshogs/ /gtsang zhing bzang ba nyid du gyur/ /dung phor 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya can/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥ gzhong pa 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ mahā ba ling+ta bā la bā te/ gu h+ya sid+dhi sa mā ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ pad+ma 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ṣa dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal a hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ sngags tshan gsum po 'di dag gi /ji ltar rigs pa brjod par bya/ /de nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi/

/mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ i dam/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta ma hā pū dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma hā laṃ pa rak+ṣa tsit+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ti ma hā pu dza hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bo dhi tsit+ta ga na gu h+ya ma hā pu dza hoḥ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rnga yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ /pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dpa' bo'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mdun du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rnga rol sgra dang spos dud can/ hūm̐ dur khrod smug nag me 'bar klong dkyil nas/ /drag po 'dul mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /'dod chags rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs/ /zhe sdang keng rus bkram pa'i steng nas bzhengs/ /gti mug sha chen spungs pa'i dbus nas bzhengs/ /nga rgyal me chen 'bar ba'i dbyings nas bzhengs/ /phrag dog rlung nag 'tshub pa'i nang nas bzhengs/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po yak+sha srin po dang / /'chi bdag gshin rje 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs/ /lha srin sde brgyad dpe dkar srog bdag dang / /bse mo dam sri sa bdag klu gnyan dang / /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pā ri wa ra sa mā dzaḥ slob dpon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bya khyung thang la babs pa bzhin/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam/ /de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /ti ra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su/ /ma hā gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /'khor bcas rgyas shing bstan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pa ri wa ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ de nas phyag 'tshal bya ba ni/ /hūm̐ rang byung pad+ma thod 'phreng drag po'i sku/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing / /'khor ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa'i/

/gu ru drag po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma hā gu ru pad+ma kro dha sa pā ri wa ra sā da ban+dha na ka ro mi/ che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs la/ /lha rdzas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo yid 'ong rnams/ /spyan shangs thugs ka sku lus dang / /zhal dang snyan du mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ /de bzhin du dhu pe nas/ shap+ta'i bar/ thog mtha' 'dra ba sbyar bas mchod/ /che mchog drag po'i lha tshogs la/ /rang byung nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog mchod/ /bsur chen spos kyi dud pas mchod/ /rdor rje dri chu'i byug pas mchod/ /bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas mchod/ /rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras mchod/ /dug lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod/ /dug gsum sku gsung thugs su mchod/ /snang srid phyag rgya chen por mchod/ /oṃ ma hā pu dza sarba pañtsa āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi sman/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs a mṛ ta/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /che mchog drag po'i tshogs la 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ nyon mongs rgyud drug 'khor ba bsgrol/ /mnyam med mkha' dbyings bde ba che/ /sbyor sgrol ma hā rak+ta'i rgyun/ /gu ru drag po'i tshogs la 'bul/ /oṃ ā hūm̐ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ bla med mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro/ /phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga yis brgyan/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol/ /artsig nertsig sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rat+na gu ru shrī bha ga wan e ka dza ti/ sarba ai ho de wa te dza sarba dharma pa la ta/ i dam ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ma hā gu ru rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal drag po dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma 'bul/

/rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yi/ /lha tshogs rnams la bstod par bya/ /o rgyan chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog 'dra ba/ /bskal pa'i me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha rab tu khrol/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi sku yi sham thabs can/ /dbu skra snum 'bol lcang lo gyen du 'khyil/ /de las tsha tsha dmar ser skar ltar 'khrug /spyan rtsa dmar nag sdang mig gyen du sgril/ /bar snang khams kyi gdon tshogs brlag par byed/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams pa ni/ /hūm̐ dgu ral dgus rab tu brgyan pa ni/ /ri rab chen po kun kyang thal bar bsnyil/ /rgya mtsho chen po kun kyang dum bur gtong / /gnam thel dkar po'i klad pa'i rgyas su 'gems/ /phyag g.yon lcags sdig kha dgu bsnams pa ni/ /yak+ṣa rak+ṣa gnod byed thams cad 'dul/ /srog bdag dpe dkar snying nas khongs nas 'byin/ /bgegs 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spyi gtsug rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas dang / /'phrin las sprul pa bya khyung rgyal po dang / /sku yi sprul pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / /gsung gi sprul pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal/ /thugs kyi sprul pa phyag na rdo rje dang / /thams cad sprul pa yak+ṣa me dbal sogs/ /gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gi tshogs/ /gu ru drag po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /rjes chog dngos grub blang ba dang / /lhag chad kha bskang brtan bzhugs dang / /gshegs gsol rtag chad mtha' bsal ba/ /bsngo smon shis brjod rim par shes/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ /rnal 'byor sgrub po bdag cag la/ /rgyas pas sbyor drug rgyas pa dang / /mos pas 'gro ba dbang du bsdus/ /drag pos dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /he ru ka yi yig brgya brjod/ /nongs pa bzod par gsol nas su/

/brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol skabs bstun bya/ /snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /khams gsum snod bcud 'od du zhu/ /bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang la thim/ /'khor rnams rang nyid gtso la thim/ /de yang rim gyis 'od du zhu/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig de la thim/ /zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo dang / /zla tshes thig le nā da rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du ngang du gyur/ /slar yang stong nyid 'od gsal las/ /rang nyid che mchog skur gyur pa'i/ /dpral mgrin snying khar oṃ ā hūm̐/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i/ /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gang gi bde legs mchog stsol ba'i/ /yi dam rnams kyi bkra shis shog /'gro ba'i don la mthu ldan pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bstan srung zhing skyong bar chad sel/ /chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i rim pa'o/ /'bring po bsgom par 'dod pa na/ /skyabs 'gro nas brtsams dngos gzhi ni/ /ting 'dzin rnam gsum bar 'dra bas/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge dmar por gyur/ /gzhal yas khang pa dor nas su/ /de rjes pad+ma nyi zla dang / /zhing chen bskyed sngags lhar bskyed nas/ /rgyas pa bzhin du bskyed bstim bya/ /bzlas pa rdzogs nas thun mtshams su/ /sman gtor rak+ta mchod pa rnams/ /bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rnga g.yab gling phran srin po'i yul/ /pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /mdun du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ swa da ban+dha na ka ro mi/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe nas brtsams shap+ta'i bar/ gong 'og 'dra ba kun la sbyar/

oṃ ma hā pu dza sarba pañtsa āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ṣa kha raṃ khā hi/ /rtsa sngags rjes su gtor sngags ni/ /gong mas sbyar bas gtor ma 'bul/ /hūm̐ rang byung thod 'phreng drag po'i sku/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing / /'khor ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa'i/ /gu ru tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dngos grub blang ba man chad nas/ /rgyas pa nyid dang 'dra ba las/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i khyad par ni/ /snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ /gdan dang 'khor rnams 'od du zhu/ /rang nyid gtso la thim nas su/ /de yang rim bzhin 'od du zhu/ /zhes pa man chad gong ltar ro/ /bsdus pa nyams su len 'dod na/ /skyabs 'gro nas bzung ting 'dzin gsum/ /bsgoms pa rgyas dang 'dra ba la/ /gzhal yas khang pa dor nas su/ /gdan dang gtso bo bskyed pa'i rjes/ /de yi spyi gtsug bya khyung rgyal/ /de steng rigs bdag snang mtha' yas/ /dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /mgrin par rta mgrin pad+ma dbang / /thugs kar phyag na rdo rje gsal/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las/ /zhes pa man chad gong mtshungs/ sman gtor rak+ta mchod byin rlabs/ /spyan 'dren brtan bzhugs phyag 'tshal rnams/ /'bring po bzhin du byas pa'i rjes/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta ma hā pu dza hoḥ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi/ bstod pa man chad 'bring po bzhin/ /bya ba 'di ni bsdus pa'o/ /de ltar gu ru drag po yi/ /sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba 'di/ /blo gsal rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /sa smyon kun dga' blo gros kyis/ /e waṃ byang chub 'byung bar bris/ /dge bas lam gyi bar chad rnams/ /zhi nas pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/
